kashika: पापाणकशब्दौ कुत्सनाभिधायिनौ, तयोः पूर्वेण समासे परनिपातः प्राप्तः, पूर्वनिपातार्थमिदमारभ्यते। पाप अणक एते सुबन्ते कुत्सितवचनैस्सह समस्येते, तत्पुरुषश्च समासो भवति। पापनापितः। पापकुलालः। अणकनापितः। अणककुलालः॥
kashikaEnglish: पाप and अणक 'contemptible' come first when compounded with contempt-words: पापनापितः 'contemptible barber'. This overrides the previous rule.
englishFull:
पाप "sinful" and अणक "insignificant" compound with words of contempt to form तत्पुरुष, standing FIRST in the compound.

By the previous sūtra, they would stand last; this sūtra reverses that.

**Examples:**
| Compound | Meaning |
|----------|---------|
| पापनापितः | "wicked barber" |
| अणकनापितः | "insignificant barber" |

This ordering is per @ref[1.2.43] and @ref[2.2.30].
